record_body:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- Fast-moving startup; strong PLG motion (self-serve signup, quick integration, heavy bursty traffic during product launches).
- Currently treated as BACKUP candidate for the structured case study + reference program. Tagged internally as: “maybe” for public case study.
- Best fit story angle (if they agree): production economics (cost/query), stability under spiky load, and using Redwood Optimize guidance to tune caching/batching.

FIRMOGRAPHICS / BUYING CONTEXT
- Team: small (founder-led); decisions made by CTO + Head of Eng.
- Procurement: lightweight (card + monthly invoice ok up to threshold). Will need DPA + SOC 2 report if they expand usage to enterprise customers.

PRODUCT USAGE (KNOWN)
- Mode: Hosted API today.
- Workloads:
  - Summarization + “agent assist” for support reps (streaming responses).
  - Embeddings for internal knowledge base search (periodic backfills + steady query traffic).
- Adoption notes: high request volume relative to size; usage is spiky (campaign-driven). Wants guardrails to avoid 429s / degraded UX.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS / SUCCESS CRITERIA
- Latency: wants “consistently fast” streaming start; cares more about p95 under burst than average.
- Cost: very cost-sensitive; target is lower cost-per-resolved-ticket vs current provider.
- Reliability: asks for clear fallback/routing guidance when capacity is constrained.
- Models: open to curated open models + Redwood-verified profiles; not committed to a single model family.
- Ops: likes Console-style breakdowns; wants a simple way to track cost by route/environment.

SECURITY / COMPLIANCE NOTES
- Not deeply regulated, but they sell into B2B SaaS teams; expects SOC 2 availability and basic controls.
- Asked about retention controls and audit logging (primarily for their own customer questionnaires).

REFERENCE PROGRAM NOTES (CASE STUDY + REFERENCE CALLS)
- Fit: Good “PLG-to-production” narrative + cost optimization story.
- Risk: Founder is cautious about public logos/quotes (“don’t want to look like we’re tied to one vendor / models change fast”).
- Proposed path:
  1) Start with reference-call-only participation (1 call / quarter max) once July metrics are stable.
  2) If relationship goes well, revisit a PUBLIC case study with limited disclosure (architecture diagram ok; no exact volumes; ranges for latency/cost).
- Champion(s): CTO is supportive in principle, but hasn’t committed to spokesperson role.

ACTIVITY TIMELINE (RECENT)
- 2025-05-29: AE noted strong PLG usage and flagged account as potential backup reference candidate; added to target list.
- 2025-06-06: SE (Simran) quick technical sync (informal) on caching/batching and handling burst traffic; shared best-practice pointers.
- 2025-06-19: AE check-in: customer open to “private reference” but not ready to approve logo/quote; requested we keep asks lightweight.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- What measurement window are they willing to share for cost-per-ticket (weekly vs monthly)?
- Will they allow publication of any quantified outcomes (ranges acceptable)?
- Do they need a formal security package before expanding usage (SOC 2 report + DPA)?

NEXT STEPS
- Simran to propose a simple metrics validation plan (p95 + cost/query) that doesn’t require new instrumentation.
- Avery to send a low-pressure reference-call-only ask with boundaries (max frequency, approved topics list).
- If July targets met, set tentative publish window for an anonymized story OR a public story with limited claims.

INTERNAL TAGS
- Reference readiness: MAYBE (not approved)
- Case study status: Not started
- Notes to Sales: Don’t lead with “public case study.” Start with reference-call-only + customer-controlled scope.
